techs.description: Rapidly changing electromagnetic fields can generate induced currents within the internal components of mechanical life forms, leading to a certain degree of interference with their logical operations.
techs.conclusion: You have unlocked the Jammer Tower, which provides more tactical choices.

techs.name: Plasma Turret
techs.description: Through stimulation of electric fields and control of magnetic fields, gaseous substances are ionized to form a rapidly moving plasma flow and achieved the ability to inflict major damage.
techs.conclusion: You've obtained Plasma Turret. It can emit high-speed plasma beams and is extremely penetrating and destructive. Such Turrets specialize in hitting space enemies and can inflict great damage.

techs.name: Titanium Ammo Box
techs.description: Since this involves Dark Fog, sharper warheads are required to pierce enemies' armor. Magnum Ammo Boxes that have been improved with titanium ingots will inflict greater damage.
techs.conclusion: You've unlocked Titanium Ammo Box. This is a type of a Magnum Ammo Box that is highly penetrating.

techs.name: Superalloy Ammo Box
techs.description: The shape and structure of shell cases are what determine the speed and penetrability of bullets. How does one achieve a higher initial speed and a steadier flight performance? A high-intensity, low-density titanium alloy is the optimal material. Let the bullets fly further!
techs.conclusion: You've unlocked Superalloy Ammo Box, the most penetrating type of magnum ammo. Even if an enemy's armor is hard to penetrate, this ammo won't fail you.

techs.name: High-Explosive Shell Set
techs.description: The newer shells require higher explosive capacity and greater stability.
techs.conclusion: You've unlocked High-explosive Shell Set. This optimized shell formula can inflict higher Explosive Damage.

techs.name: Supersonic Missile Set
techs.description: More precise control and propulsion systems enable higher levels of accuracy and greater attack capabilities for missiles.
techs.conclusion: You've unlocked Supersonic Missile Set. These missiles fly faster and are more destructive than most.

techs.name: Crystal Shell Set
techs.description: High-pressure gases and shock waves resulting from explosions can quickly rupture surrounding materials and turn them into fast-moving shards. Such shards have huge amounts of kinetic energy and can destroy and damage targets in a short time.
techs.conclusion: You've unlocked Crystal Shell Set. It has a more intense shattering effect that can inflict more damage.

techs.name: Gravity Missile Set
techs.description: Missiles' surrounding space is warped due to the negative gravitational pressure of Strange Matter, thereby accelerating missiles. Flatten all enemies!
techs.conclusion: You've unlocked Gravity Missile Set. Strange Matter's negative gravitational pressure will keep accelerating it.

techs.name: Antimatter Capsule
techs.description: The majority of enemies will be destroyed immediately due to the enormous amount of energy generated from the annihilation reaction as matter and antimatter collide.
techs.conclusion: You've unlocked Antimatter Capsule. The majority of enemies will be immediately destroyed by its annihilation reaction, making it the ultimate energy weapon.

techs.name: Prototype
techs.description: In addition to Turrets in fixed areas, Icarus also needs some active means to launch attack. A simply built Combat Drone would be its best partner.
techs.conclusion: You've unlocked Prototype. It provides assurance to Icarus when the latter launches attacks.

techs.name: Precision Drone
techs.description: Power and Weapon systems are enhanced based on a modified prototype to give them a longer range and faster speed.
techs.conclusion: You've unlocked Precision Drone. Upgraded by the prototype, it has the longest attack range of all fighters.

techs.name: Attack Drone
techs.description: Based on a prototype that is constantly being optimized, more powerful Armor and Weapon systems are equipped to attack enemies nearby and provide powerful support to Icarus on the battlefield.
techs.conclusion: You've unlocked Attack Drone. Modified from the prototype, it has a stronger weapon system that can attack enemies in close quarters.

techs.name: Corvette
techs.description: As Dark Fog launches raids here and there, the fight is no longer limited to the ground. It's time to deploy space forces!
techs.conclusion: You've unlocked Corvette. This is a type of small spacecraft. When the battlefield shifts from ground to space, your space force will play a vital role.

techs.name: Destroyer
techs.description: We've realized the importance and complexity of Warships from the fights against Dark Fog space forces. Warships require strong power and excellent survival capabilities if they are to help Icarus gain an advantage on the battlefield.
techs.conclusion: You've unlocked Destroyer. This is a type of medium-sized Warships. It is powerful and sturdy, and advantageous to have in the space battle.

techs.name: Suppressing Capsule
techs.description: The upgraded capsule recipe enhances the slow down effect.
techs.conclusion: You've unlocked Suppressing Capsule. It induces stronger slow down effect compareing to Jamming Capsule.

techs.name: Battlefield Analysis Base
techs.description: We need an autonomous battlefield command and a combat support system when Icarus is away from the base.
techs.conclusion: You've unlocked Battlefield Analysis Base. Equipped with 12 Construction Drones, it can automatically build and repair. It can also deploy Combat Drones to the base and complete defense missions.

techs.name: Digital Analog Computation
techs.description:
To avoid wasting valuable computing power on useless matters, digital simulation enables analog computations via discrete electrical signals and outputs answers to complicated problems, much like a biological brain does.
Silicon-based neurons are a fundamental form of silicon-based life. If given a high degree of evolutionary freedom, they may evolve into a new "Dark Fog".
Warning: This technology has been prohibited by the COSMO Technology Ethics Committee. Please initiate such research manually.
techs.conclusion: You've unlocked Digital Analog Computation. You can now produce Self-evolution Lab. Its matrix production speed is three times faster than a Matrix Lab.

techs.name: Matter Recombination
techs.description:
Matter Recombinator re-composes raw materials at particle size to massively accelerate manufacturing speed. Yet these core components can only be obtained from high-level Dark Fog Debris.
Matter Recombinator can replicate any product if the recipe is correct. Organisms, abiotic entities, Dark Fog... Maybe it can replicate itself.
Warning: This technology has been prohibited by the COSMO Technology Ethics Committee. Please initiate such research manually.
techs.conclusion: You've obtained Matter Re-combination technology. This enables matter to be re-composed at particle size. In combination with Quantum Printing technology, you will be able to build faster re-composing assemblers.

techs.name: Negentropy Recursion
techs.description:
Assuming regulated energy is constantly inputted, matter can generate negentropy by self-similar calls. Such notion implies the possibility of transitioning from disordered matter to orderliness.
It requires placing the whole system under extreme conditions to generate negentropy. For inexperienced engineers, this operation may impact the robustness and safety of the entire system.
Warning: This technology has been prohibited by the COSMO Technology Ethics Committee. Please initiate such research manually.
techs.conclusion: You've revealed the mystery of negentropy recursion. After energy has been put in continuously, negentropy generated from a Smelter can be efficiently purified, thus making smelting more efficient.

techs.name: High-Density Controlled Annihilation
techs.description:
The mass of Strange Matter is much higher than that of hydrogen, so if it is used as the raw material for the annihilation reaction, we will be able to obtain more efficient energy sources.
The Strange Matter will convert matter to strange matter on contact and this process is uncontrolled. What about converting antimatter to strange antimatter? It only exists in rumors.
Warning: This technology has been prohibited by the COSMO Technology Ethics Committee. Please initiate such research manually.
techs.conclusion: You have mastered the Ultimate Controllable Annihilation technology and can now manufacture Strange Annihilation Fuel Rods.
